आ: ā́, adv. 	—1. hither, unto, as prefix w. verbs of motion; 	—2. conjunctively, thereto, besides;  ca…ā, both…and, 855; 	—3. asseveratively, (up to, i. e.) quite, entirely, 7320; 	—4. as prep., w. abl.: hither from, all the way from; and then [293c], all the way to, until, 4913, 6414, 10320, 1056, 1062; as far as, 10510. [cf. Lat. ā, ‘from,’ which is not akin w. ab, ‘from.’]
आकर: ākará, m. 	—1. accumulation, abundance; 	—2. mine. [√3kṛ + ā, q. v.]
आकरणय: √ākaraṇaya (ākarṇayati; ākarṇita; ākarṇya). listen; give ear to; hear. [denom. fr. the possessive adj. *ākarṇa, ‘having the ear to, i. e. listening.’]
आकर्षक: ākarṣaka, a. attractive; --f. -ikā [1222d], Pleasanton, as name of a town. [√kṛṣ + ā.]
आकर्षिकाख्य: ākarṣikākhya, a. having the name ākarṣikā. [ākhyā.]
आकार: ākāra, m. make; shape; appearance. [√1kṛ + ā: cf. ākṛti.]
आकारवत्: ākāravant, a. like the Eng. shapely. [ākāra.]
आकारवन्त्: ākāravant, a. like the Eng. shapely. [ākāra.]
आकाश: ākāśá, in Veda, m.; later, n. free or open space; sky. [prop. ‘outlook, clearness,’ √kāś + ā.]
आकुल: ākula, a. 	—1. bestrewn, covered, filled; 	—2. fig. confused; agitated. [√3kṛ + ā, q. v.]
आकुलय: √ākulaya (ākulayati). confuse; ākulita, at one's wit's end. [ākula.]
आकृति: ā́kṛti, f. make; shape; appearance. [√1kṛ + ā, 1157. 1d: cf. ākāra.]
आखु: ākhú, m. mold-warp; mouse. [‘burrower,’ √khā + ā, 1178a end.]
आख्या: ākhyā, f. name; at end of cpds, having… as name. [√khyā + ā.]
आगन्तु: āgantu, m. arrival; and so, as in Eng., person arriving. [√gam + ā, 1161.]
आगमन: āgamana, n. a coming hither; w. punar, a returning. [√gam + ā.]
आगस्: ā́gas, n. sin. [orig., perhaps, ‘a slip,’ √añj: cf. ἄγος, ‘guilt’: different is ἅγος, see √yaj.]
आचमन: ācamana, n. the rinsing of the mouth. [√cam + ā.]
आचमनीय: ācamanīya, m. dish for use in rinsing the mouth. [ācamana, 1215.]
आचार: ācāra, m. walk and conversation; conduct; usage; observance. [√car + ā.]
आचार्य: ācāryà, m. teacher, esp. of the Veda. [perhaps, ‘the man of observances,’ fr. ācāra, 1212d 4.]
आजरसम्: ājarasám, adv. to old age. [from the phrase ā́ jarás-am.]
आजरसाय: ājarasā́ya, adv. to old age. [dat. (1113) formed fr. the preceding, as if that were acc. of ājarasá.]
आजि: ājí, m. race; contest; battle. [√aj, 1155: cf. ἀγ-ών, ‘contest.’]
आज्य: ā́jya, n. clarified butter (for anointing, etc.); cf. ghṛta. [√añj + ā, see 10020: for mg, cf. Eng. noun smear, ‘ointment,’ and verb smear.]
आज्यशेष: ājya-śeṣa, m. n. rest of the clarified butter.
आज्याहुति: ājyāhutí, f. oblation of clarified butter. [āhuti.]
आञ्जन: ā́ñjana, n. ointment. [√añj + ā: cf. Lat. unguen, ‘ointment.’]
आढ्य: āḍhyá, a. wealthy; rich. [perhaps fr. arthya.]
आत्: ā́t, adv. thereupon; ā́d íd, then indeed. [lit. ‘from that,’ abl. of á, 1114a.]
आत्मक: ātmaka, for ātman in mg 4 at end of cpds [1222, 1307]; e. g. māra_ātmaka, murder-natured,  murderous.
आत्मन्: ātmán, m. 	—1. breath; 	—2. spirit; soul (cf. 848N.), as principle of life and feeling; 	—3. self; very often so used as a simple reflexive pron. [514]; e. g., myself, 3616; thyself, 2615; himself, 419; in genitive: his, 1716; her, 465; one's own, 2118, 5822; 	—4. nature, character, peculiarity; esp. at end of cpds, see ātmaka; 	—5. the soul κατ᾽ ἐξοχήν, the soul of the universe,  668. [cf. ἀϋτμήν, ‘breath’; ἀτμός, ‘vapor’; AS. ǣþm, ǣðm, ‘breath’: for mg, cf. πνεῦμα and Lat. anima, ‘breath, spirit.’]
आत्मप्रभ: ātma-prabha, a. having his or their own splendor. [prabhā, 354.]
आत्मभव: ātma-bhava, m. the coming into existence of one's self.
आत्मवत्: ātmavát, adv. as one's self. [ātma, i. e. ātman: 1107.]
आत्मसन्देह: ātma-saṃdeha, m. danger of one's self, personal risk.
आत्मसंदेह: ātma-saṃdeha, m. danger of one's self, personal risk.
आत्मौपम्य: ātmaupamya, n. likeness to one's self, i. e. a putting one's self in another's place. [aupamya.]
आदर: ādara, m. respect, notice, care. [√2dṛ + ā, ‘regard.’]
आदहन: ādáhana, n. burning-place, place of cremation.  [√dah + ā.]
आदि: ādi, m. 	—1. in-ception, beginning, 608; ādim ādatte, he makes a beginning; ādāv eva, just before, just now; 	—2. esp. at end of adj. cpds [see 1302c 1]: …-ādi, having …as the beginning, i. e.…and so forth; or, the qualified noun being omitted, and the adj. cpd being used as subst.,…and so forth. [undoubtedly fr. √1dā + ā, ‘take,’ ‘a taking hold of, i. e. beginning,’ 1155. 2e: for mg, cf. Lat. in-cipere, Ger. an-fangen, ‘take hold of, begin.’]
आदिक: ādika, equiv. to ādi in use 2. [1222, 1307.]
आदित्य: ādityá, m. 	—1. son of Aditi, name applied to the gods of the heavenly light, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, etc.; 	—2. Aditya,  name of the sun-god, son of Aditi; the sun. [áditi, 1211.]
आद्य: ādya, a. first; equiv. to ādi in use 2. [ādi, 1211.]
आधृष्य: ādhṛṣya, grdv. to be ventured against; approachable. [√dhṛṣ + ā, 963d.]
आधेय: ādheya, n. a placing, esp. of the sacred fire. [√1dhā + ā, ‘put,’ 1213c.]
आध्वर्यव: ā́dhvaryava, n. service of sacrificing priest. [adhvaryú, 1208c.]
आनडुह: ā́naḍuha, a. of a bull, taurine. [anaḍúh, weak form of anaḍvah, 404; 1208a.]
आनन: ānana, n. mouth; face. [prop. ‘the breather,’ √an: cf. ἠνεσ-, ‘face,’ in προσ-ηνής and ἀπ-ηνής, ‘with face turned towards, ’ ‘with face averted’: for mg, cf. nayana.]
आप्: √āp (āpnóti; ā́pa; ā́pat; āpsyáti; āptá; ā́ptum; āptvā́; -ā́pya; āpyáte; ī́psati [1030]; āpáyati). reach; win; get; bring upon one's self; --āptá: --1. having reached; extending over; and so, adequate,  suitable, fit; 	—2. having reached, i. e. being near or intimate, and so, as m., a friend; --īpsitá, whom or what one desires to obtain, sought for, desired. [prob. for ā-ap, 108g, see ápas: cf. ἤπιος, ‘approachable, friendly’; Lat. ap-iscor, ‘reach,’ ap-ere, ‘seize, fasten’; ἅπτω (√ἀφ for ἀπ), ‘fasten.’] + abhi, reach to a thing, attain; desid. strive to win; caus. cause to reach the mark, i. e. carry out fully, 9612. + ava, come upon, fall in with; obtain, acquire; take upon one's self; incur. + pra, reach; arrive; come upon; catch; win, obtain, get; incur; --prāpta: reached, found, caught, obtained; reached, arrived, having come; --caus. cause to arrive at, bring to, 5317; prāpaṇīya, to be brought to, 5315. + vi, reach through, pervade, 669.
आपद्: āpad, f. misfortune. [lit. ‘a getting into’ (trouble), √pad + ā: for specialization of mg, cf. ārti, and Eng. ac-cident, lit. ‘a happening’ (of trouble).]
आपि: āpí, m. friend. [‘one who has reached or stands near another’ (cf. āpta), √āp: cf. ἤπιος, s. v. āp.]
आप्तदक्षिण: āpta-dakṣiṇa, a. having or accompanied by suitable presents. [dakṣiṇā, 3342.]
आभरण: ābharaṇa, n. ornament (jewels, etc.). [‘what is worn,’ √bhṛ + ā: for mg, cf. φᾶρος, ‘garment,’ w. φέρω, and Ger. Tracht, ‘dress,’ w. tragen, ‘wear.’]
आम: āmá, a. raw. [cf. ὠμός, ‘raw’; Lat. amārus, ‘bitter.’]
आमिष: āmiṣa, n. flesh. [cf. āmá and ā́mis.]
आमिस्: ā́mis, n. raw flesh; flesh. [cf. āmá.]
आमोद: āmóda, a. gladdening; as m. fragrance. [√mud + ā.]
आयतन: āyátana, n. foot-hold; resting-place; esp. place of the sacred fire, fire-place. [√yat + ā.]
आयतलोचन: ā́yata-locana, a. having long eyes. [√yam + ā.]
आयस: āyasá, a. metallic, of iron; as n. metal, iron. [áyas, 1208a.]
आयाम: āyāma, m. like Eng. extent, i. e. length. [√yam + ā, ‘extend.’]
आयु: āyú, a. active, lively. [√i, 1178a: prob. akin are ἠύς, *ἠϳύ-ς, ἐύς, ‘active, doughty, mighty,’ εὐ-, ‘strongly,’ εὖ, generalized, ‘well’: for mg of āyú, cf. the phrase “full of go.”]
आयुष्मत्: ā́yuṣmant, a. having life or vitality; long-lived; old. [ā́yus, 1235a.]
आयुष्मन्त्: ā́yuṣmant, a. having life or vitality; long-lived; old. [ā́yus, 1235a.]
आयुस्: ā́yus, n. (activity, liveliness, and so) life; vitality; personified as a genius, Ayus, 8518; period or duration of life; long life; (like Eng. life, i. e.) living creatures. [√i, 1154, cf. āy-ú: cf. αἰ-ών, Lat. ae-vu-m, AS. ǣw, ǣ, ‘life-time, time’; AS. āwa, ā, Eng. aye, ‘ever’; AS. ǣf-re, Eng. ev-er.]
आरण्यक: āraṇyaka, a. pertaining to the wilderness;  as n. forest-treatise (to be read in the solitude of the wilderness--Whitney, p. xvi.). [áraṇya, 1222e.]
आराधन: ārādhana, n. the gratifying, propitiation, service. [√rādh + ā, caus.]
आरोग्य: ārogya, n. lit. diseaseless-ness, i. e. health. [aroga.]
आरोह: ārohá, m. the swelling hips or buttocks of a woman. [prop. ‘the seat’ on which a child is carried astride by its mother, √ruh + ā, ‘get upon, take one's seat upon’: see aṅka and cf. the words of an ogress, MBh., āruha mama śroṇīṃ, neṣyāmi tvāṃ vihāyasā, ‘get upon my hip, I will carry thee through the air.’]
आर्त: ā́rta, a. visited, esp. by trouble; afflicted; stricken; distressed. [√ṛ + ā, q. v.: for mg, cf. American slang phrase gone for.]
आर्ति: ā́rti, f. a visitation (of evil), i. e. trouble, misfortune, see 9315N. [√ṛ + ā: for mg, cf. ārta and āpad.]
आर्य: ā́rya, a. belonging to the faithful, i. e., as m., man of one's own tribe, an Aryan, as designation of a man of the Vedic Indian tribes; as adj. Aryan; noble; reverend (used in respectful address). [aryá, 1208f: cf. Avestan airya, ‘Aryan’; New Persian, īrān, ‘Persia’; Hdt. vii. 62, οἱ Μῆδοι ἐκα-λέοντο πάλαι Ἄριοι; Keltic nom. eriu, acc. erinn, name of Ireland; Eng. Ir-ish: cf. arí, aryá.]
आलस्यवचन: ālasya-vacana, n. sloth-dictum, as designation for the ignava ratio or fatalist's argument.
आविस्: āvís, adv. forth to sight, in view; w. kṛ, make visible. [1078.]
आशा: āśā́, f. hope. [younger form of āśás.]
ā́śā, f. region; quarter (of the sky). [specialized from ‘place, objective point, that which one reaches,’ √1aś, ‘reach.’]
आशिस्: āśís [392], f. wish or prayer, esp. for good. [√śās + ā, 639, 2252: cf. praśís.]
आशीर्वाद: āśīr-vāda, m. expression of a (good) wish, i. e. a benediction. [āśís, cf. 392.]
आशीर्वादाभिधानवत्: āśīrvādābhidhānavant, a. containing a designation of a benediction. [āśīrvāda + abhidhāna, 1233.]
आशीर्वादाभिधानवन्त्: āśīrvādābhidhānavant, a. containing a designation of a benediction. [āśīrvāda + abhidhāna, 1233.]
आशु: āśú, a. swift. [cf. ὠκύ-ς, ‘swift’; Lat. ōc-ior, ‘swifter.’]
आश्रम: āśrama, m. 	—1. (place of self-castigation,  i. e.) hermitage; 	—2. stadium in a Brahman's religious life (of which there are four: that of the student or brahmacārin, that of the householder or gṛhastha, that of the hermit or vānaprastha, and that of the beggar or bhikṣu), see 653N. [√śram + ā.]
आश्रय: āśraya, m. that on which anything leans or rests; support; refuge; protection; authority. [√śri + ā.]
आश्रयभूत: āśraya-bhūta, a. having become a protection,  i. e., as m., protector. [1273c.]
आस्: ās, excl. of joy or of displeasure. ah!

√ās (ā́ste [628], ā́sīna [6193]; āsā́ṃ cakre; ā́siṣṭa; āsiṣyáte; āsitá; ā́situm; āsitvā́; -ā́sya). 	—1. sit; seat one's self; settle down, 931; 	—2. abide; dwell, 8519; stay; remain; continue, 6414; 	—3. w. ppl. [1075c], continue (doing anything), keep on, 3214, 18. [cf. ἦσ-ται, ‘sits’; Lat. ānus, *ās-nu-s, ‘seat, buttocks’; Old Lat. āsa, Lat. āra, ‘family-seat, hearth, altar.’] + adhi, take one's place in, i. e. visit, 4916; get into (shoes), i. e. put on, 4517. + upa, sit by (in sign of readiness to serve), wait upon (a command), 924; sit by (expectantly), sit waiting for, 914. + pary-upa, sit around, surround, 27.
आसार: āsāra, m. (like Eng. colloq. a pour, i. e.) pouring rain. [√sṛ + ā, ‘run.’]
आसुर: āsurá, a. demonic; as m. demon. [ásura, 1208f.]
आसेचन: āsécana, n. cavity (into which one pours). [√sic + ā.]
आसेचनवत्: āsecanavant, a. having a cavity, hollow. [āsecana.]
आसेचनवन्त्: āsecanavant, a. having a cavity, hollow. [āsecana.]
आहवनीय: āhavanī́ya, a. of or for the oblation; w. agni, oblation-fire; as m., without agni, oblation-fire (the one that receives the oblation), see 1022N. [āhavana, 1215.]
आहार: āhāra, m. the taking to one's self (of food), eating; what one takes, i. e. food. [√hṛ + ā.]
आहारादि: āhārādi, n. food and so forth. [ādi, 1302c 1.]
आहिताग्नि: ā́hitāgni, a. having a set or established fire; as m. one who is keeping alive a sacred fire. [āhita, √1dhā + ā, ‘set’: 1299a.]
आहुति: ā́huti, f. oblation, offering (used both of the act and of the thing offered); cf. the later word homa. [√hu + ā: w. -huti, cf. χύ-σι-ς, ‘a pouring.’]
आह्वान: āhvāna, n. call; invitation. [√hū or hvā + ā.]
